Vuelta 2026: GPX



Slideshow 1/22
The 2026 Vuelta a España features seven mountain stages, six hilly stages, six flat stages and two (flat) time trials. The GPX files for all stages can be downloaded free of charge on this page, allowing you to ride the routes yourself whenever it suits you.

If you’d like to try the routes for yourself, please be aware that professional races take place on closed roads. Some sections may run against the flow of one-way streets, while others might be on roads that are normally off-limits to cyclists.

Click on the links in the GPX column for the corresponding downloads.
